title: Zero to RAG (OpenAI as Embedding Provider)

cues.en: All right, in this companion video, we are doing a very tiny tweak to the main video,
cues.zh: 好，這支補充影片只會對主影片做一個很小的調整，

cues.en: and that is switching out Azure OpenAI for normal OpenAI.
cues.zh: 也就是將 Azure OpenAI 換成一般的 OpenAI。

cues.en: So in order to do that, of course, we need an API key for OpenAI and not Azure, and we need the models from them.
cues.zh: 因此，當然需要 OpenAI 的 API 金鑰，而不是 Azure 的金鑰，也需要它提供的模型。

cues.en: Beyond that, we are going to change out a slight piece of code, so let's get started.
cues.zh: 除此之外，只需要修改一小段程式碼，那就開始吧。

cues.en: So up in the different models up here, we can go and find the different model names,
cues.zh: 到這裡的模型頁面，可以找到不同的模型名稱。

cues.en: so let's go to models, but essentially we're going to use the same ones that we used before.
cues.zh: 進到 Models，不過基本上還是會使用與之前相同的模型。

cues.en: So we're going to use Luna for our agents, so here I am in OpenAI specific project here,
cues.zh: 代理程式會使用 Luna。這裡是 OpenAI 專用的專案，

cues.en: and I'm going to put in the model, and find the embedding one, let's just switch to embedding.
cues.zh: 先填入模型，再找到嵌入模型，切換到 Embedding 分類。

cues.en: Here we have the embedding models, let's use the small like we did in Azure, and then we
cues.zh: 這裡就是嵌入模型，和 Azure 範例一樣使用 small 版本，接著，

cues.en: are going to need an OpenAI key.
cues.zh: 需要一把 OpenAI 金鑰。

cues.en: So we need an account with OpenAI, and go to that platform.OpenAI.
cues.zh: 因此，要有 OpenAI 帳號，並前往 platform.openai.com。

cues.en: I'm going to show my key here, but it's going to be deleted after the fact, so no harm in you seeing it.
cues.zh: 我會在這裡展示金鑰，但事後就會刪除，所以看到也沒有關係。

cues.en: Grab the key, and we are ready to go in terms of configuration.
cues.zh: 取得金鑰後，設定部分就準備好了。

cues.en: In terms of NuGet package, we actually don't need anything else, we actually need to take one away, which is the Azure OpenAI, which I already done, because we have the Microsoft
cues.zh: 至於 NuGet 套件，實際上不用新增，反而要移除 Azure OpenAI。我已經先移除了，因為目前的 Microsoft，

cues.en: agent framework with OpenAI, and that actually gives the one we need.
cues.zh: Agent Framework OpenAI 套件，已經提供我們需要的內容。

cues.en: So all we need to do is we need to make our client and our embedding generator, and then everything else should be the same.
cues.zh: 所以只要建立用戶端與嵌入生成器，其他內容應該都一樣。

cues.en: So we can go in and say OpenAI client instead of Azure OpenAI client, and that just needs
cues.zh: 將 AzureOpenAIClient 改成 OpenAIClient，而它只需要，

cues.en: an API key, so we call it OpenAPI key here.
cues.zh: API 金鑰，這裡使用 OpenAIKey。

cues.en: We get our clients, and from the client we can say get embedding clients with the embedding
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，呼叫 GetEmbeddingClient，傳入嵌入，

cues.en: model, just the same, and say as AI embedding generator.
cues.zh: 模型名稱，做法相同，再呼叫 AsIEmbeddingGenerator。

cues.en: We get exactly the same type of objects, so whenever we do the in-memory down here, or
cues.zh: 我們會取得完全相同類型的物件，所以不論下方使用 InMemory，或，

cues.en: some other combination, again we can mix and match whatever you wish.
cues.zh: 其他組合，都能依需求自由搭配。

cues.en: You could even take a Google model and give it the embeddings of OpenAI model, because
cues.zh: 甚至也能使用 Google 的對話模型，搭配 OpenAI 模型產生的嵌入向量，因為，

cues.en: it's the vector search tool that takes care of turning it back into real, almost text.
cues.zh: 向量搜尋工具會負責取得實際資料，再把文字內容交給模型。

cues.en: But in this case, we're just using the in-memory vector store, and when we come down to the build here, it's exactly the same as well.
cues.zh: 不過，這個範例先用 InMemoryVectorStore，而建立代理程式的部分，也完全相同。

cues.en: So if we just run it, we will see that it will show exactly the same setup, and hopefully
cues.zh: 因此，直接執行，就能看到與之前相同的流程，希望也會，

cues.en: give us back S42 as the password, which it did.
cues.zh: 回傳 guest42 這個密碼。確實成功了。

cues.en: So not much to switch between Azure OpenAI and OpenAI, the only thing really being the different clients.
cues.zh: 所以，在 Azure OpenAI 與 OpenAI 之間切換，沒有太多需要修改的地方，主要差異就是用戶端類型。

cues.en: Instead of Azure OpenAI client, it's the OpenAI.
cues.zh: 把 AzureOpenAIClient 換成 OpenAIClient 即可。

cues.en: So simple and easy to switch between them, but that's everything.
cues.zh: 切換非常簡單，以上就是全部內容。

cues.en: See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下一支影片再見。
